research_question: Can the eleven non-announcement quarterly Core-92 characteristics be reconstructed from point-in-time Compustat and extended through 2025 without changing their historical cross-sectional meaning?
timing_rule: Construct signals at the quarterly statement level; make them available on actual rdq when valid and otherwise four months after datadate, using the already frozen Compustat point-in-time table. Join the most recently available statement to each stock-month through the historical CCM link.
validation_metrics: median monthly mean absolute rank difference on [-1,1]
exact agreement for discrete nincr and ms
failure_rule: Report any failed feature separately and do not silently substitute another definition. Formula corrections require a new experiment version with a documented source discrepancy. No model training or sealed-period pricing output is allowed in V015.
